shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): resolve Ajv import and validation function issues

- Import ajv module correctly to fix TypeScript 'type-only' import error
- Move Ajv instantiation into compileSchema function to satisfy declare-near-use linting rule
- Remove unnecessary 'as any' type assertion by creating Ajv instance where needed
- Restructure formatValidationErrors to satisfy prefer-early-return linting rule
- Fix optional chaining in acceptance test to reduce member chain depth

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main 2>&1
npm run typecheck && npm run eslint && npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -20
